title: Generalize Trinity Directed Port Graph
description: Trinity operates on general directed property port graphs, not DAGs. Remove DAG-only canvas assumptions (enforce_acyclic), wire reorganize to shared force layout, generalize flatPosition derivation for disconnected components, and extend force-graph schema allowlist.
summary: Generalized Trinity off DAG constraints and aligned canvas rendering with puzzle 2d port graphs. Removed enforce_acyclic, wired force-directed reorganize, generalized flatPosition for disconnected components, and routed vector rendering through BoardHost. Fixed rectangle node/port caps: trinity_graph_to_board_fixture and force-layout adapter now emit circle nodes (shape circle, radius) with handleKind port at left/right angles; rebuild_engine uses create_node; kind catalogs registered for port handles. Rebuilt trinity_rewrite WASM. Validated cargo test trinity_rewrite (11) and play vitest rewrite (19) + jack (14).
